description: Two covering items over one consuming constituent are a document error, even when its input token has no attachments (engine §9.3, §11.4).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item $w:word | ($b:bb $w:word) | ($w:word $a:ii) | ($b:bb $w:word $a:ii) %emits ($b) $w ($a)



%rule word "w" :: W | "z" :: Z

%rule bb "b" :: B %emits $



%rule ii "i" :: I %emits $



```
